== Acquisition ==
This skill can be temporarily acquired by [[Primary profession|primary]] [[Necromancer]]s by talking to [[Kuunavang]] in [[Raisu Palace]], [[Imperial Sanctum]] or [[Raisu Palace (explorable area)]].

== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Animate Vampiric Horror}}

== Notes ==
* The skill descriptions omit that this skill can only be recharged when gaining a [[Morale Boost]].
* Can be [[Echo]]ed, but each Necromancer can only control one at a time.
* The [[minion]] summoned with Star Servant counts as a [[Flesh Golem]], but does not leave an exploitable [[corpse]].
{{anomaly| The skill descriptions do not state that the horror will [[Life stealing|steal 25 health]] and 3 energy with each attack.}}
